signals.thesis: Applied Materials breakout on 16+ analyst target raises — strongest consensus upgrade in semis this quarter. AI capex cycle driving record equipment orders for advanced packaging and EUV lithography. Cerebras IPO +68% confirms insatiable AI compute demand directly benefiting AMAT. Entry $418–$436 below recent high, stop $393 below gap support.

Cisco post-earnings momentum continues after 12+ analyst raises and gap from $93 to $123 on 194M volume (8x normal). AI infrastructure pivot validated — enterprise networking demand inflecting on data center buildout. Entering pullback consolidation zone $110–$119 after initial gap surge. Webex AI + Splunk integration creating SaaS revenue streams.

Vertiv riding AI data center power infrastructure wave with 3 analyst raises this week (BofA, Barclays, Jefferies). Power and cooling for AI clusters is the picks-and-shovels play of 2026. CSCO earnings blowout validates enterprise data center demand read-through. Entry $355–$374, stop below $336 prior consolidation floor.

Schwab breakout above $88 resistance on 5 analyst raises and rising rate environment. 30Y yield >5.1% — highest in a year — expands net interest margin, the core earnings driver. Financials sector +5% last week provides broad tailwind. Entry $88–$92 with target $99 prior high.

Palo Alto continues 52-week high breakout — Jefferies Buy $265, Baird Outperform $220. Platformization driving 30%+ ARR growth. EARNINGS MAY 19 (Tuesday after-hours) — consider half position pre-earnings, full on confirmation. Cybersecurity spend non-discretionary as AI attack surfaces expand.

Novo Nordisk pullback to $42.5–$45.5 support after 15% correction from highs. GLP-1 franchise (Ozempic/Wegovy) is a secular multi-year growth story with pipeline expansion into cardiovascular and NASH. EU pharma provides geographic diversification away from US tech concentration.

BBVA breakout above $21 resistance on European bank sector strength. Rising rate environment expands NIM. Hostile bid for Sabadell creating M&A premium. EU financials outperforming as ECB holds rates. Entry $21.2–$22.2, stop below $20.0 prior support.

JD.com momentum on Trump-Xi summit trade deal catalyst. Direct e-commerce beneficiary of US-China trade normalization. Trading at 8x forward PE — deep value vs US peers. KWEB ETF breakout confirms China internet sector rotation. Entry $30–$32.5, strong support at $29.

XLK momentum ETF capturing broad tech sector strength — CSCO blowout + AMAT raises + Cerebras IPO confirming AI capex cycle. Tech +5% last week. Entry $240–$251, stop below $228 50-DMA. Diversified exposure to AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AVGO.

IBB momentum on healthcare sector rotation — NVO GLP-1 tailwind extending to broader biotech. M&A wave accelerating with 3 deals >$5B this quarter. Entry $140–$146, stop below $133 prior support. Defensive diversification from tech-heavy portfolio.

stressScenarios.description: Fed rate hike +100bps: equities fall via ERP compression, bonds reprice
Equity market crash -20%: beta-adjusted drawdown across all positions
VIX spike to 40: volatility repricing, equity decline proportional to vol exposure
Crypto crash: BTC -30%, altcoins down more, minimal equity impact
Geopolitical crisis: risk-off flight to safety, equity decline, gold/USD rally
